# <span id="aanchor494"></span> Tabular Display Configuration

Use the Tabular Display Config screen to control the tabular views in the Volume Editor. You can select the columns to display and change the display order.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Tabular Display Config screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **Application** group, select **Tabular Display Configuration**.
    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 552;height: 354;" />
3.  Select a fluid phase, meter type, and grid type (along with a data category) to view the available columns for that combination.
4.  To change the data that is displayed in the tabular view, click **Edit** and then use the right and left arrow buttons to make a column visible or to hide a column. To change the display order, use the up and down arrow buttons.
5.  The configuration that you define on the Tabular Display Config screen applies to all FLOWCAL  users. If you select **Can Show** or **Can Hide** for a column, you can change the display within the Volume Editor. The changes will only apply to that session.

</div>
